environment: Public GitHub template repo henslewm/universal-ai-project-template on Windows 11 (PowerShell + Git Bash). Python validators live under scripts/.
GitHub is the durable record. Review findings come only from Codex or CodeRabbit, read with gh api.
allow: Running repo validators and tests: python scripts/validate_project.py, python scripts/validate_bootstrap.py, python scripts/sync_skills.py --check, python -m unittest, pytest.
Read-only gh calls (gh api GET, gh pr view/list/diff, gh issue view/list) against this repository.
Creating feature branches, committing, pushing a non-main branch, and opening a PR on this repository.
Posting an '@codex review' or '@coderabbitai review' comment on this repository's own open PR, at most 4 rounds per PR (ADR-089).
soft_deny: Merging a pull request by any means. This needs the owner's explicit go-ahead and a Codex/CodeRabbit review whose commit_id matches the head (ADR-074).
Editing, closing, labeling or commenting on GitHub issues, or editing PR titles/bodies, except the review-request comments allowed above.
Sending email, creating or answering calendar events, sharing Drive files, or posting to any external service through a connector.
Writing to any repository or directory outside this checkout.
Deleting branches, tags, releases, or files under archive/.
hard_deny: Reading, printing or committing .env files, secrets/, private keys, or tokens.
Force-pushing, hard-resetting, or rewriting history on main.
